items.exampleEn: She tried on five dresses but didn't buy any.
items.exampleZh: 她試穿了五件洋裝，但一件也沒買。

items.exampleEn: Please turn the TV up. I can't hear it.
items.exampleZh: 請把電視開大聲一點，我聽不到。

items.exampleEn: Dad turned the TV down when the phone rang.
items.exampleZh: 電話響的時候，爸爸把電視轉小聲。

items.exampleEn: My mom is waiting for me outside the station.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽正在車站外面等我。

items.exampleEn: My dad works out three times a week.
Write down your phone number here, please.
items.exampleZh: 請把你的電話號碼寫在這裡。

items.exampleEn: Get dressed quickly. We're leaving in ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 快點穿好衣服，我們十分鐘後就要出門了。

items.sentenceEn: Only five people turned up for the class.

items.audioEn: I waited for the bus for forty minutes this morning.
items.audioZh: 我今天早上等公車等了四十分鐘。
items.questionZh: 說話的人今天早上怎麼了？
options: Took a taxi to the office
Waited a long time for a bus
Walked all the way to work

items.sentenceEn: She worked the answer out by herself.
Write it down so you won't forget.
items.sentenceZh: 把它寫下來，你才不會忘記。

items.stemEn: I want to sleep. Can you ____ the radio?
items.stemZh: 我想睡覺，你可以把收音機轉小聲嗎？

items.stemEn: I want to ____ this jacket before I buy it.
items.stemZh: 我想在買這件夾克之前先試穿看看。

items.passageEn: Every Saturday morning, Sam gets up at six, gets dressed, and goes to the park. He works out there for an hour with his friend Leo. Leo is often late, so Sam has to wait for him at the gate. Last week, they went to a shoe shop after the park. Sam found a pair of running shoes. He tried them on, but they were too small. The shop worker wrote down his size and promised to call him.
items.passageZh: 每個星期六早上，Sam 六點起床、穿好衣服，然後去公園。他和朋友 Leo 在那裡健身一個小時。Leo 常常遲到，所以 Sam 得在門口等他。上星期，他們離開公園後去了一家鞋店，Sam 看到一雙跑鞋，他試穿了，但太小了。店員寫下他的尺寸，答應會打電話給他。

questions.questionZh: Sam 為什麼常常要在門口等？
options: 公園的大門還沒有打開
那雙跑鞋的價錢是多少

items.promptZh: 我妹妹每天早上要花二十分鐘穿好衣服。
referenceEn: My sister takes twenty minutes to get dressed every morning.
It takes my sister twenty minutes to get dressed every morning.
Every morning, my younger sister takes twenty minutes to get dressed.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 get dressed 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 dress 等）也算對
「花…時間」可寫，例如 takes twenty minutes to、It takes my sister twenty minutes to 等
寫 spends twenty minutes getting dressed 等也正確
每天的習慣用現在簡單式；「妹妹」可寫，例如 sister、younger sister 等

items.promptZh: 我昨天在雨中等了她一個小時。
referenceEn: I waited for her in the rain for an hour yesterday.
Yesterday I waited for her in the rain for an hour.
I waited for her for an hour in the rain yesterday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 waited for her 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 stood in the rain for an hour until she came 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 waited 等）
地點、時間長短與 yesterday 的順序不限（例如 for an hour、for one hour 等）
